verdict.rationale: Turso documents official SDKs in TypeScript, Python, Rust, and Go. The TypeScript SDK has a quickstart with push()/pull() sync calls, a fetch-only serverless package for edge runtimes, a Next.js guide, and SDK-level token authorization docs. Missing for 10: in-depth docs evidence for the Python, Rust and Go SDKs (only named on the marketing page), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: SDKs in TypeScript, Python, Rust, and Go.

Push local writes to Turso Cloud

await db.push();
The `@tursodatabase/serverless` package connects to Turso using only the `fetch` API — no native dependencies, making it the smallest option for edge and serverless runtimes.
Set up Turso in your Next.js project in minutes.
